stem: In late October a Voltmarkt store shows 6 weeks of cover on a game console, using the in-stock sales rate of the last 4 weeks. Black Week and the run-up to Sinterklaas start in a few weeks. What is the main risk in reading this number?

options.text: Sales are about to rise, so the stock will probably last fewer than 6 weeks
The rate includes out-of-stock days, so the cover is probably overstated
Cover ignores the console's price, so the stock may be worth too much
Six weeks of cover is too much stock, so the console should be marked down now
